comment: VOICEVOX characters for Japanese exam listening (BRIEF_PHASE8 N-00(d)), the set Tsumugi vetted: 春日部つむぎ (8) and 四国めたん (2) for women, 玄野武宏 (11) for men, with a lower variant for a second male speaker. 青山龍星 is not used (his terms require companies to apply before publishing; Tsumugi D-170).
